attributes.description: Overview of Backstage audit log activity: event volume by event ID and plugin, actor activity, severity distribution, and failures. Backstage audit events carry no session identifier, so the actor-vs-event heatmaps approximate a user's journey rather than a true session replay. Outcome (event.outcome: success / failure / unknown) reflects the audited operation's result.
